title: Expose only the approved pytest runtime to sanitized worker validation
objective: Close the exact B753/B674 false-negative path: isolated validation preserves credential-free HOME but cannot import the operator-installed pytest package. Add a bounded read-only validation-only Python runtime binding without exposing arbitrary user-site content, credentials, or writable package state.
acceptance: Reproduce python3 -m pytest import failure under the current sanitized validation HOME while parent-host pytest is installed.

For pytest validation only, resolve one canonical trusted Python package root, reject symlinks/untrusted ownership/world-writable paths, bind it read-only in the validation sandbox and prepend only that exact path to PYTHONPATH while preserving the card's relative project PYTHONPATH.

Do not copy packages, expose the real HOME, inherit credentials, add arbitrary host paths or make package roots writable. Non-pytest validation commands must keep byte-equivalent environment/path behavior.
Fail closed with an explicit infrastructure error when no approved pytest runtime exists. Request-private executable scratch and cleanup from B753 must remain intact.

Use a standalone unittest-compatible regression command so this task's own validation does not depend on the bug it repairs; cover pytest success, untrusted/symlink rejection, non-pytest unchanged behavior, credential isolation and cleanup.
commit_contract: NO_COMMIT. Worker repairs only the isolated validation pytest runtime boundary and stops at Codex review.
